items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: I worked with Sarah Vaughan... We had a very good rhythm section with her. I played piano

ctx.x: Was that where he graduated from?

Uh-huh. And he went back and they treated him like a king. And that's the only thing I remember, other than the one time I worked with Sarah Vaughan, and of course I have a lot of relatives there. One was a school principal and the other one was a school teacher. You know, that was the thing in those days.

items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: We called her Sass, you know? That's her nickname. And I said, 'Well, Sass, now what are you thinking about now?'

ctx.x: I do too. I just remember you and Kenny. And Sarah.

Gee, I'm trying to remember who else was in the group. But Sarah and I, we were in the lobby, and I can always tell by an expression on her face when she's serious about something. And she had her daughter with her. We called her Sass, you know? That's her nickname. And I said, "Well, Sass, now what are you thinking about now?" And she would say, "Jones, I'm just trying to think about what to sing and how I'm going to sing it." I told her, "All you need to do is just get up to the microphone, and it'll come out."
That's the way it works with her.
